words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell after rain.
words.sentence1: The sudden downpour released the petrichor that filled the afternoon air. (The sudden downpour released the earthy smell that filled the afternoon air.)
words.sentence2: I find the scent of petrichor incredibly grounding during a summer storm. (I find the scent of petrichor incredibly grounding during a summer storm.)

words.translation: The time spent chatting with people after a meal.
words.sentence1: Disfrutamos de una larga sobremesa después de la cena. (We enjoyed a long time of post-meal conversation after dinner.)
words.sentence2: La sobremesa es mi parte favorita de las reuniones familiares. (The post-meal chat is my favorite part of family gatherings.)

words.translation: Lasting for a very short time.
words.sentence1: La beauté d'une fleur est souvent éphémère. (The beauty of a flower is often fleeting.)
words.sentence2: Nous avons partagé un moment éphémère de paix au bord du lac. (We shared a fleeting moment of peace by the lake.)

words.translation: An ache for distant places; being homesick for places you have never been.
words.sentence1: Das Fernweh packte mich, als ich die Fotos der Reise sah. (Wanderlust seized me when I saw the travel photos.)
words.sentence2: Manchmal leide ich unter starkem Fernweh in meinem Büro. (Sometimes I suffer from a strong longing for distant places in my office.)

words.translation: Sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees.
words.sentence1: 森の中で木漏れ日がとても美しかった。 (The sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest was very beautiful.)
words.sentence2: 木漏れ日を浴びながら散歩をするのが好きです。 (I like to take a walk while bathed in sunlight filtering through the trees.)

words.sentence1: Facciamo una passeggiata nel parco prima di cena. (Let's take a stroll in the park before dinner.)
words.sentence2: La sua passeggiata serale è un rito che non salta mai. (His evening walk is a ritual he never misses.)

words.translation: A fateful coincidence or a connection between two people.
words.sentence1: 我们能相遇真的是缘分。 (It is truly fate that we were able to meet.)
words.sentence2: 缘分让两个陌生人在异国他乡相识。 (Fate brought two strangers together in a foreign land.)

words.translation: The ability to gauge others' moods and act accordingly.
words.sentence1: 그는 눈치가 빨라서 상황을 금방 파악한다. (He has quick social intuition and grasps the situation immediately.)
words.sentence2: 눈치 없이 행동하지 마세요. (Don't act without considering the social atmosphere/others' feelings.)

words.sentence1: ខ្ញុំស្រលាញ់អ្នកដោយអស់ពីចិត្ត។ (I love you with all my heart.)
words.sentence2: ក្តីស្រលាញ់គឺជាកម្លាំងចិត្តដ៏អស្ចារ្យ។ (Love is an amazing source of motivation.)

words.translation: Sociability, conviviality, or a cozy social gathering.
words.sentence1: Die geselligheid om die kampvuur was heerlik. (The conviviality around the campfire was delightful.)
words.sentence2: Hy hou van die geselligheid van 'n groot familie. (He loves the sociability of a large family.)
